title: puccinellia sublaevis
intro: Puccinellia sublaevis, commonly known as Saltwort or Salt Grass, is a type of annual or perennial plant that belongs to the grass family (Poaceae). It is a salt-tolerant plant that is widely distributed in coastal areas and salt marshes. Puccinellia sublaevis has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
